reason: The README clearly describes a persistent memory plugin that stores searchable entries, exposes memory management tools and local API routes, and injects recalled memories into agent prompts, making memory-context its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 为智能体会话提供可持久化、可搜索的记忆存储，并通过工具、自动召回和设置面板进行管理。
summaries.en: Provides persistent, searchable memory for agent sessions through model tools, automatic recall in prompts, and a settings panel.

capabilities: model-facing memory save, search, list, read, and delete tools
automatic memory recall insertion into agent system prompts
local JSON API routes for memory management
web panel for browsing and editing memories
